title: What's New in Cloth NeXt 2.7.6
subtitle: Gaia solver support and direct backend control.

highlights.title: Gaia is ready
highlights.description: Gaia 0.22 is the preferred solver for new installations. Lumen remains available, and existing verified Velune installations still work.

highlights.title: Choose your backend
highlights.description: Select AUTO, CUDA, ROCm, or CPU in Preferences. ROCm is available with a warning while broader AMD verification continues.

highlights.title: Switch with confidence
highlights.description: Solver and backend changes were exercised across consecutive bakes in one Blender session.
